title: Unit Event — Grow Glorious Glow — Episode4 The Resolve to Stay on Top

meta.Episode: Episode4 — The Resolve to Stay on Top
meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! haven't received any job offers in a while, but one day, an email arrives for Shizuku. It invites her to audition for popular cosmetics brand Grand Fleur's new commercial...

rows.Line: A few days later
Production Office

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm Shizuku Hinomori from MORE MORE JUMP! Thank you for having me here today.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
Yes, thank you for coming.
We're almost ready to begin fitting you, so please have a seat and wait here.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Understood.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (All we're doing today is trying on our outfits for the shoot.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But everybody involved is here, so I have to stay focused.)
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Hagiyama...!

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: Once again, I look forward to working with you on this commercial.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I'm also looking forward to working with you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You were so incredible during that audition. I promise to do everything I can in order to keep up with you.

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line:
Thank you...
I really appreciate you saying that, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, Hagiyama...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Can you tell me what was going through your mind during the audition?

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: What was going through my mind...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes.
I know it's a very open-ended question...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I'd like to have a better understanding of your thought process, since we're going to be working together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I want to know how you were able to shine so brilliantly that time.

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line:
...
I just...

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line:
My thought was...
To pose in a way which exceeded everyone's expectations.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Their expectations...?

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line:
I have to keep going above and beyond.
My presence has to be powerful enough to blow others away.

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: I was sure that was the answer, so I decided to pose accordingly.

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: After all, the theme of this commercial demands that from us...

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: And more importantly, I think that's how a top idol ought to be, at all times.

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line:
But I'm still nowhere near that level.
I have to keep finding ways to improve.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hagiyama...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(But she's already so dazzling.
Despite that, she still feels...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (No, her resolve is precisely why her technical acuity is so high.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But I...)
One hour later
Fitting Area

rows.Speaker: Stylists
rows.Line:
Okay!
I'm seeing no issues with your outfit!

rows.Speaker: Stylists
rows.Line:
Actually, I'm sorry...
I need to quickly go ask about which accessories we'll be using, so would you mind waiting here for a bit? Call it a short break.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, that's fine.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It seems like they'll be done fitting me very soon...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Which means I need to begin strengthening my resolve in preparation for our shoot...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(No...
I can think that all I want, but I don't actually know how to do that...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, but...
I'd like to go for a bit of fresh air.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Keep it together...
I can't let this chance slip.)

rows.Speaker: Oikawa's Voice
rows.Line: Yikes, what do we do now?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Huh? Mr. Oikawa...?
And that looks like the director, Mr. Saeki, next to him...)

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line:
I don't know...
Our client has every right to make this request, but as things stand, the balance just isn't there...

rows.Speaker: Oikawa
rows.Line: Right. Hinomori isn't bad for this...

rows.Speaker: Oikawa
rows.Line: But she sort of pales in comparison to Hagiyama's brilliant aura.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It's just as I suspected...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But I don't blame them for feeling that way. It's true, compared to her, I leave a lot to be desired in skill and in mindset...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I have to accept that, and keep finding ways to improve.)

rows.Speaker: Oikawa
rows.Line: Maybe asking Hinomori to audition was a mistake...

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Oh, were you the one who said to get her in to audition for this?

rows.Speaker: Oikawa
rows.Line:
Yeah, it was me.
We didn't stand to gain much since she doesn't belong to an agency, but I wanted to see that aura again.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (What...?)

rows.Speaker: Oikawa
rows.Line: You wouldn't believe how dazzling she was back then. She was just like Hagiyama. No, even more brilliant...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Mr. Oikawa...
He thought that highly of me...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But to say I possessed an aura that was more brilliant than Hagiyama's seems...)

rows.Speaker: Oikawa
rows.Line:
She told me herself.
When I asked her why a fifteen-year-old girl like her had such a driven look about her.

rows.Speaker: Oikawa
rows.Line: She said...

rows.Speaker: Oikawa
rows.Line: “Because I'm the lead of Cheerful * Days.”

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Really...? Well, I guess anyone would feel that way if they were the lead of a group like Cheerful * Days.

rows.Speaker: Oikawa
rows.Line:
*Nod*
It just goes to show that people change when they have something to lose.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line:
True...
That being said, if we don't see some improvement, then things aren't going to go well.

rows.Speaker: Oikawa
rows.Line:
Right...
If things don't immediately go well, then we'll have to redo the storyboards with Hagiyama as the sole focus.

rows.Speaker: Oikawa
rows.Line: It's a real shame, thinking about that brilliance. But at the end of the day, business is business.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Mr. Oikawa asked me to audition because he was so impressed by the way I was back then...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But I'm falling short of his expectations...!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I don't want to disappoint him any further...!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Because if I fail here, then he and the others will likely never ask me to work with them ever again.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Not only will that affect my future, it may even jeopardize the future of MORE MORE JUMP!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I accepted this audition looking to lift everyone up. If I were to drag them down instead... No, I won't let that happen.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I have to get myself together...!!
